item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Nupur at a wall switch after washing; water droplets are still on her hand near the switch.

Which claim about safety is correct?

options.A: She may touch the switch with wet hands.
options.B: She must not touch any switch later, even with dry hands during normal use.
options.C: She should dry her hands before touching the switch.
options.D: She may touch the switch with wet hands if the switch looks cool and shows no heating.
